title: Practice: Boxing Stance
source: Practice Mode tutorial, lesson 1 of the Boxing Fundamentals Path (practiceLessons.js › boxing_stance: its steps and calls). Footage: the owner's stance clip from Angel's camera, deblurred (tools/deblur.py), raw-footage/blurry-angel.deblur.mp4.

props.description: Learn your base, guard, and foot position.

cues.label: LEAD FOOT
cues.say: Coach: "Left foot forward if you're right-handed. Toes toward your target."

cues.label: KNEES
cues.say: Coach: "Soft knees. Weight on the balls of your feet."

cues.text: Hands up. Chin down. Eyes forward.
cues.label: CHIN
cues.say: Coach: "Elbows close to the ribs. Your chin hides behind your hands."

watch.label: LOCKED
watch.say: Coach: "Straight legs can't move or punch. Sink an inch."

next.name: Guard + Footwork
next.description: Protect yourself and move with balance.
